Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely anchored on Emma Swan as the one who pulled Excalibur and steered the search toward confirming Jennifer Morrison, instead of first verifying the canonical event. This bias ignored that King Arthur (played by Liam Garrigan) is shown pulling the sword from the stone in OUaT, risking a wrong actor attribution and causing inefficient, misleading follow-up searches.
